schema.description: A POS Terminal registered with a PaymentGateway and optionally bound to a Store.

paymentGatewayAccountId.description: The ID of the PaymentGatewayAccount this Terminal belongs to.

paymentGateway.description: Essential information about a PaymentGateway, used when embedded in other resources (e.g., Transactions, Terminals).

name.description: The display name of the PaymentGateway (e.g., "Visa", "Mastercard", "Edenred").

paymentAction.description: The type of checkout action required by the payment gateway.

x-enum-descriptions.OTP: One-Time Password authentication is required. The customer needs to enter an OTP code.

x-enum-descriptions.REDIRECT: The customer must be redirected to an external URL to complete the payment.

x-enum-descriptions.DROPIN: An embedded payment form (drop-in) can be used within your application.

paymentAction.title: PaymentGateways.CheckoutAction

image.description: URL of the image to display for this PaymentGateway.

icon.description: URL of the icon to display for this PaymentGateway.

paymentGateway.title: PaymentGateways.PaymentGatewayEssential

storeId.description: The ID of the Store this Terminal is bound to, when applicable.

externalId.description: The identifier assigned to the Terminal by the PaymentGateway provider.

name.description: The display name of the Terminal.

brand.description: The brand of the physical device.

model.description: The model of the physical device.

serialNumber.description: The serial number of the physical device.

externalCreatedAt.description: The UTC timestamp when the Terminal was created in the PaymentGateway provider system.

externalUpdatedAt.description: The UTC timestamp when the Terminal was last updated in the PaymentGateway provider system.

schema.title: Terminal
